testCases.title: Verify all product information is displayed correctly
steps: Navigate to the product detail page.
expectedResults: The product image, name, description, price, category badge, and brand badge are displayed correctly.

testCases.title: Verify related products section is displayed
steps: Navigate to the product detail page.
expectedResults: The related products section is displayed below the main product information.

testCases.title: Verify related products are clickable
steps: Navigate to the product detail page.
Click on each related product in the related products section.
expectedResults: Each click navigates to the respective detail page of the related product.
